tasks.label: risk-analytics-run-pipeline
tasks.detail: End-to-end run through Airflow for one as-of date (see docs/scripts-reference.md).

tasks.label: risk-analytics-run-pipeline-local-python
tasks.detail: Same flow without Airflow, using Docker services and the local virtual environment.

tasks.label: risk-analytics-validate-dags
tasks.detail: Parse airflow/dags with a real DagBag and assert the 27 expected ra_* DAG ids.

tasks.label: risk-analytics-validate-pipeline-status
tasks.detail: Check registered DAGs, Nessie, and ODS/risk_metrics data from the host.

tasks.label: risk-analytics-health-check
tasks.detail: Probe every service endpoint, including the published risk_metrics table.
tasks.command: docker compose exec business-ui python /opt/risk_analytics/scripts/health_check.py --host host.docker.internal --postgres-host postgres --check-iceberg

tasks.label: risk-analytics-unit-tests
tasks.detail: Run the host unit test suite.

tasks.label: risk-analytics-list-airflow-dags
tasks.detail: List DAGs as Airflow sees them; use this to spot stale metadata after a rename.
tasks.command: docker compose exec airflow-scheduler airflow dags list

tasks.label: risk-analytics-list-dag-runs
tasks.detail: Recent runs of the bootstrap DAG.
tasks.command: docker compose exec airflow-scheduler airflow dags list-runs -d ra_createtables_and_data

tasks.label: risk-analytics-trigger-orchestration
tasks.detail: Trigger STAGE -> ODS -> risk metrics when source data already exists.
tasks.command: docker compose exec airflow-scheduler airflow dags trigger ra_stage_to_ods_orchestration --conf '{"as_of_date":"2026-07-18"}'

tasks.label: risk-analytics-tail-airflow-logs
tasks.detail: Scheduler and triggerer logs; the triggerer runs the deferred waits and Kafka sensors.

tasks.label: risk-analytics-tail-ui-logs
tasks.detail: Business UI, developer UI, and operations API logs.
tasks.command: docker compose logs --tail 120 business-ui developer-ui links-api

tasks.label: risk-analytics-tail-kafka-stream-logs
tasks.detail: Structured streaming consumer that lands Kafka events and emits trigger events.

tasks.label: risk-analytics-restart-spark
tasks.detail: Recreate the Spark services after changing images or Spark configuration.
tasks.command: docker compose up -d --force-recreate spark-master spark-worker spark-connect

tasks.label: risk-analytics-service-state
tasks.detail: Container state for every service, including exited init containers.

tasks.label: risk-analytics-nessie-main-ref
tasks.detail: Confirm the Nessie main branch is reachable from the host.
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:19120/api/v2/trees/main' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; Write-Output ('STATUS=' + [int]$r.StatusCode); Write-Output ($r.Content.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(500, $r.Content.Length))) } catch { Write-Output ('ERROR=' + $_.Exception.Message) }"

tasks.label: risk-analytics-show-ods-tables
tasks.detail: List the ODS tables through Spark Connect.
tasks.command: docker compose exec business-ui python -c "from risk_analytics.spark import create_spark_session; s = create_spark_session('vscode-show-tables'); s.sql('SHOW TABLES IN nessie.risk_analytics_ods').show(truncate=False); s.stop()"

tasks.label: risk-analytics-risk-metrics-counts
tasks.detail: Row count and latest as-of date in the published metrics table.
tasks.command: docker compose exec business-ui python -c "from risk_analytics.spark import create_spark_session; s = create_spark_session('vscode-metrics-count'); s.sql('SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, MAX(as_of_date) AS latest_as_of_date FROM nessie.risk_analytics_ods.risk_metrics').show(); s.stop()"

tasks.label: risk-analytics-docs-serve
tasks.detail: Serve the MkDocs site locally on http://127.0.0.1:8000.
